trials.sample: First pair per category from exposed validation-v2
trials.interpretation: Failed pilot. Passing structure/evidence validation does not imply correct semantic extraction.

trials.sample: Same first pair per category from exposed validation-v2
trials.interpretation: Pilot contains only five known-positive pairs: no precision or false-positive claim is possible. Housing falsely treated reciprocal routes as a conflict and also failed quote validation.

trials.method: Per-kind schema with explicit field guide and nullable required core fields
trials.interpretation: Roles and housing period improved, but optional fields and unsupported hard constraints still prevent matches; quotations sometimes paraphrased.

trials.method: Identical prompt/post: original schema versus json_object
trials.interpretation: Plain JSON restored previously skipped price/model/time keys but introduced wrong role, field names, types, time values and evidence shapes. It is not a usable replacement.

trials.method: Direct pair judgment with explicit role-direction rules
trials.selection: First match, reject, uncertain pair in each category
trials.interpretation: Failed stratified development pilot. Unknown allocation, item facts and travel details were sometimes assumed. Invalid responses are never shown as high matches, but their raw decisions remain in the logs.

trials.method: Controlled decision-first versus evidence-first output order
trials.selection: First hall match and first hall uncertain pair in validation-v2 file order; decision-first then evidence-first for each pair
trials.interpretation: Evidence-first fixed the positive housing pair and removed a false high on the uncertain pair, but called uncertainty a direction conflict with a wrong rationale. Only one of four three-way classifications was correct. Two exposed targeted cases cannot establish accuracy; unequal prompt-cache reuse and concurrent local preparation prevent a fair speed comparison.
